why: B has the nicer solid-wood desk, but its reception armchair is an upright waiting-room chair with reddish mahogany legs that clash with the grey-brown desk. A's black-brown desk, black chair, glossy black lamp and dark-framed leather lounge chair read as one coherent look, with a real reading chair for the corner, though its cognac leather strays from the black, dark-wood and grey palette.
